description: Implementation of FrameDecoderState class methods for HTTP/2 frame decoding, including padding handling and error reporting.

classes.name: FrameDecoderState
classes.description: Class managing the state of decoding an HTTP/2 frame, including padding and error handling.

methods.name: ReadPadLength
methods.description: Reads the padding length from the buffer, updates remaining payload and padding, and reports pad length if requested.

methods.name: SkipPadding
methods.description: Skips over padding bytes in the buffer, updating remaining padding.

methods.name: ReportFrameSizeError
methods.description: Reports a frame size error to the listener and returns an error status.
